from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document extracted with key fields needed for the task."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document")
    stated_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document text")
    document_type_label: str | None = Field(description="The type of document (e.g., 行政判决书，刑事裁定书) as indicated in the header")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[DocumentInfo]
